items.new: The season for the Line, the equator, finally came close. Every day, whenever Ahab came up from his cabin and looked aloft, the watchful helmsman would make a show of handling his spokes, and the eager sailors would hurry to the braces and stand there with all their eyes converging on the nailed doubloon, impatient for the order to point the ship's prow toward the equator. In due time the order came. It was nearly high noon, and Ahab, seated in the bow of his boat, which was hoisted high, was about to take his usual daily sighting of the sun to find his latitude.
